_readme: Every string Halo shows. Copy this file to <code>.json (fa, ar, zh-Hans...) and translate the VALUES only. Keys beginning with _ are notes and are never displayed.
_placeholders: {0} and {1} are filled in by Halo, in that order. Move them wherever the sentence needs them, but do not add or drop one - a count that does not match leaves the line untranslated rather than crashing.
_missing: A key you leave out, or a whole file you have not written yet, falls back to English. Partial translations are fine and ship fine.
_naming: Prefixes group the surface: reports.* is the bug reporter, notice.* is the banners Halo raises itself. notice.app.* are the small names above a banner's title.
reports.off: Reports are switched off: report.endpoint in settings.json is empty.
reports.customNotHttps: report.endpoint in settings.json is not a valid https:// address.
reports.builtInNotHttps: The built-in endpoint is not a valid https:// address.
